quantity.description: Quantity in the item base unit.
Requested quantity in base units, decimal string.

unit_cost.description: Recorded local-currency item unit cost, decimal string.

estimated_cost.description: quantity multiplied by unit_cost, decimal string; no currency rounding applied.

forecast_stock.description: Calculate an explainable company-wide baseline from completed historical Sale ledger movements and current inventory. Includes Sale returns, excludes incoming supply, open commitments, seasonality and production. Fails on incomplete history.

tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID for this Business Central environment.

environment.description: Business Central Online environment name, such as Sandbox or Production.

forecast_days.description: Forecast calendar days from the current stock snapshot.

snapshot_at.description: UTC timestamp of the current-stock snapshot.

net_sales_quantity.description: Negative sum of Sale quantities, including returns; decimal string.

current_inventory.description: Current company-wide inventory in base units; decimal string.

average_daily_demand.description: Nonnegative net sales divided by all calendar days in the history; decimal string.

forecast_demand.description: Average daily demand multiplied by forecast_days; decimal string.

projected_inventory.description: Current inventory minus baseline forecast demand; decimal string.

days_of_cover.description: Nonnegative stock divided by average daily demand, or null when demand is zero.

create_purchase_order.description: Create a purchase order for a vendor, optionally with item lines. Does not receive or invoice the order. Check existing orders before retrying an uncertain result to avoid duplicates.

tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID for this Business Central environment.

environment.description: Business Central Online environment name, such as Sandbox or Production.

vendor_id.description: Vendor UUID. Supply either vendor_id or vendor_number, never both.

vendor_number.description: Vendor number. Supply either vendor_number or vendor_id, never both.

order_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to use Business Central defaults.

posting_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to use Business Central defaults.

requested_receipt_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to use Business Central defaults.

currency_code.description: Business Central currency code. Empty string selects local currency; omit for vendor default.

lines.description: Optional item lines created with the header using deep insert. Omit to create a header only.

quantity.description: Quantity in the selected unit of measure, or the item default when omitted.

direct_unit_cost.description: Optional unit cost in the order currency. Omit for Business Central pricing.

unit_of_measure_code.description: Optional item unit of measure code.

remove_purchase_order.description: Permanently delete a purchase order and its lines using its ID and current ETag. Business Central enforces permissions and document deletion rules. Does not reverse posted receipts or invoices.

tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID for this Business Central environment.

environment.description: Business Central Online environment name, such as Sandbox or Production.

etag.description: Exact @odata.etag from get_purchase_order, including quotes and optional W/ prefix. Wildcards are not accepted; a changed order must be reviewed again.

deleted.description: True only after Business Central confirms deletion with HTTP 204.
